mutants.old:
AS run_id
  FROM instrument i
  JOIN acquisition_state s      ON s.instrument_id = i.instrument_id
  JOIN run_instrument_result r  ON r.run_id = s.last_run_id
                               AND r.instrument_id = s.instrument_id
